cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Remember my suggestion to put the spare key under the flowerpot? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And now we're locked out beside a very useful flowerpot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say whose idea while you lift it. The pot can't accept all the credit.

mechanism: A directs a lockout rescue but adapts the lifting work so B gives A credit for the earlier spare-key suggestion.
confusable: Ordinary praise-seeking lacks returning to a specific previously dismissed contribution once its practical value is visible.
comparison: Stage alternative contests collective credit for a repair; this one uses a concrete household solution and task-sharing.
seedUse: Spare-key seed keeps useful callback; S02 changes physical roles to preserve cooperation while requesting named credit.
